title: scrub workroom text from devbin's shipped files and guard it out; fleet stays out of the public snapshot
body:
## The problem

devbin's shipped files (the paths ST0010's public snapshot carries: bin/, lib/, tests/, docs/, packaging/, .github/, README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG, RELEASES) hold comments and test titles written for the private workroom, not for a public reader. ST0010's pre-publication review (six readers, every file) found these classes:

- whiteboard node monikers used as people or actors (hv, vc, cc, dc, devbin-cc, `<project>/<node>`), in comments and in test NAMES, which print on every run;
- AI critic credits, eg `(critic-shell on 0139)`, `the critic's review`;
- quoted rulings, eg `hv ruled on 2026-09-23 ...`;
- pointers into intent/ (design D-numbers, `intent/st/...`, MODULES.md, LESSONS.md), which the public repository does not carry;
- "estate", "sleeve", "the fleet" and "whiteboard" in their private sense (estate and fleet are also product vocabulary in infra; keep those);
- internal incident dates and workroom commit shas that do not resolve in a public repository;
- an AI writing in the first person, eg "I briefly made `> 1` a breach";
- fixture committer identities such as `dc@test` and `vc@test`.

Nothing here is a secret or a client name; it reads as internal chatter in a public repository.

## hv's ruling (2026-10-24, decision 59)

Rewrite it in main, so every later public snapshot is clean without a per-snapshot strip, and add a guard that keeps it out.

The `fleet` command stays private: the public snapshot leaves out bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet, bin/.devbin/fleet.roots, its help page and tests/unit/fleet.bats. Those files are outside this scrub and outside the guard. Any other shipped file that depends on fleet being present (a test, a help index, a doc) is found and fixed here, so the snapshot's suite stays green without fleet.

## Done when

1. Every class above is gone from the shipped paths, fleet's files excepted. Each comment keeps its technical reason and drops who said it, which review pass found it and when; a test title says what it checks.
2. A guard (a tree scan in the suite, beside neutral and contract) refuses node monikers as actors, critic credits, ruling quotes and intent/ pointers in the shipped paths, with fleet's files exempt by path. It is red on main before the scrub and green after.
3. No behaviour changes: the full suite is green, and the only diffs are comments, test names, fixture identities and docs prose.
4. The public candidate (main's allow-list minus fleet's files) runs the full suite green.


## Resolution

Fixed at 5e39f6c7 and 108c46d5 (the scrub, in two halves around 0213, with the guard and tests/shipped.paths), landed on landing suite 20261024-1249 at 4c2f866f, and at 60c4035f (the guard's list arm), landed on landing suite 20261024-1756 at 62c632b4 (2474 of 2474 ok, 5 environmental skips, the errors seal empty). dc built it in scratch clones, and vc landed it.

- Done when 1: comments, test titles, fixture identities, help pages and docs across the shipped paths drop collaborator handles as actors, review credits, rulings, design decision numbers, pointers into intent/, the private sense of estate, fleet and session, incident dates and workroom shas. Each comment keeps its technical reason. Fixture committers are dev@test. fleet's own files are outside the scrub.
- Done when 2: tests/unit/workroom.bats reads every text file tests/shipped.paths names, less itself, for handles, review credits, rulings and intent/ pointers, each arm red on planted lines and passing innocent ones before it reads the tree. tests/shipped.paths is the one list of what ships, and fleet's files are its `:(exclude)` lines.
- Done when 3: no lib/ or bin/ code changes. shfmt -mn is identical before and after for every changed shell file, apart from the declared fixture and message strings in tests and two declared output strings (fullcycle's guarded-release note and check's fork-size note).
- Done when 4: the fleet-less candidate first failed the guard's own list arm alone, which required the excluded files to exist. The fix at 60c4035f checks only the entries the list includes. The candidate suite from 62c632b4, built by tests/shipped.paths with fleet's files absent, then ran green: suite 20261024-1805, 2319 of 2319 ok, 5 environmental skips, the errors seal empty.

> **0216 addendum (2026-10-24, by dc on vc's instruction):** the fleet-less candidate suite failed the guard's list arm alone, at `tests/unit/workroom.bats:141`: the arm required every line of `tests/shipped.paths`, the `:(exclude)` lines included, to name a tracked file, and in the public tree the fleet command's excluded files are absent by design. 60c4035f (built as 65a91012) requires a tracked file only of the entries the list includes; an exclusion may name nothing. The count of exclusion lines by line and the check that every exclusion excludes stay. The arm's title now says "every entry it includes names a tracked file". `workroom.bats` was red on the old candidate (from 19d15680, list arm only, BSD and GNU), and green on the candidate from 65a91012 and in the source tree at dfcb603c, BSD and GNU.
